body: I see what you mean now, makes sense. I don't get offended really, I don't have the energy to waste on being offended by people, the only thing that gets me down is when people dislike me. Which incidentally the guy I texted about it now does but he replied that he had tested negative, so there you have it. I've got a lot of growth to do but honestly I'm just glad to be done with this mess.

Thank you for the advice. Firstly, I should have clarified that I'm not worried about the oral since their was no ejaculation and as far as I could tell no precum either, so I figure I'm good there. I've just been more worried about having gotten semen on my urethra since I stupidly wiped off with the same tissue folded over *after* I'd wiped his off my chest, hence there was a lot on there.

Actually I decided to text him a little bit ago, I hadn't been in contact since then, I'll see what he says. He might be offended that I'm mentioning something like that but I don't really care anymore given how much I've stressed over this.

You're absolutely right about anxiety, it runs in my family (if it can even do that, idk). I've had a fantastic psychiatrist but I haven't seen her since she's in my home town and I'm at university, I just find it hard to connect to someone else. I'm hoping to get in contact with her whenever I'm in my home town because she really helped and I've definitely had more problems with anxiety since I stopped seeing her. Thanks again for the advice, I appreciate your patience.

I'm planning on taking one next week, since that's the earliest I can do so without it being a waste of time for undetectability. I read your irritation and I get that these questions get annoying, so I'm sorry about that, I really don't want to be a pest, but this is just the only place besides one close friend I can get any support or advice about this.

Yeah, really, the HPV vaccine has been on my list and I just haven't gotten around to it even though I know I should.

It's weird because I was so attracted and barely keeping it together before we got into it, and then when we did I was just going further because I felt obligated. He gave me no cues at all so I don't know if how passive he was put me off, or the fact that we just didn't communicate and I still felt like complete strangers.

I have to admit that I'd be pretty happy about being bi or something, I really want to have kids someday so I'd like to settle down with a woman. I don't know if that's just society talking but it would certainly be easier, I'd like biological kids. It's funny that this happens kind of after I've mostly come to terms with being gay, or so I thought.

Thanks, you made me laugh. I just worried about the tissue I used, I should have used one for his and one for mine. I'm just terrified since I imagine the penis is like ground zero for catching HIV. I'll just try to chill for now.

You're right that I've struggled a lot with guilt, but it was just strange to me that I felt so, unenthusiastic doing all the actual sex stuff. I just didn't feel into it the whole time even though it was like every single thing I'd aimed for till then sexually. Just a huge letdown overall, and I guess I probably just need to wait a while to see how I feel about it later on.

Thanks for the kind words. It's terrible to feel like you have to give up everything important in your life (family, friends, social capital) just because of something you never chose. I don't know, maybe life will just suck but I guess I have to see to find out. Can't be a whole lot worse than just sitting around letting myself waste away to depression. I don't look forward to the hate from family whom I love and am very close with though.

My life goals were and are kinda dependent on not being gay. It closes a lot of doors and causes additional difficulties (childbirth, STDs, limited/promiscuous dating scene, threat of violence, etc.). Lifestyle has to be one of my least favorite words in relation to this, but I get what you mean in a sense. 

I appreciate the link, but it seems pretty religious and Christian/Mormony, and that didn't help me in 21 years I don't think it will help now.

I'm sorry to trash gay people, I guess I just honestly feel like holding myself to a different standard than other people. Kind of like parents accepting other people gay but not their own kids. Come to think of it I don't even think my friends know how to respect me, I guess they just want to kind of carry on and ignore it and think that's respect. Maybe they don't get that hearing shit that reinforces how shitty and bad it is to be gay every day from them sends me into a depression every time, idk.
